name: mrpc
license: Microsoft Research's terms on its download page (the mirror carries none; verify before any publication)
notes: The Microsoft Research Paraphrase Corpus: 5,801 sentence pairs from news clusters, each judged by annotators as semantically equivalent or not (Quality 1 / 0); the official train (4,076) and test (1,725) splits in their original untokenized text, from a GitHub mirror (the SentEval and GLUE copies are tokenized). Tab-separated, UTF-8 with a byte-order mark: Quality, #1 ID, #2 ID, #1 String, #2 String.
